newsitem.title: ITALY: Milan Bourse Mib30 blue chip index at new high.
newsitem.headline: Milan Bourse Mib30 blue chip index at new high.

text.p: The Milan stock market's Mib30 blue chip index touched a new record high of 20,935 on Monday while the Fib30 stock futures September contract also peaked at 21,215.
The all-share Mibtel index was also at a new high of 13,779 after setting an earlier record at 13,714.
Dealers said the market was boosted by foreign buying on the expected but good news from Brussels as European finance ministers approved Italy's EMU convergence plans.

Traders noted that the Italian stock market had a way to go yet before equalling historic highs of May 20, 1986 when the authoritative BCI (Comit) index reached 908.20. The BCI index, updated once a day, closed on Friday at 851.94.
